A '''skirmish''' took place at the [[Riverview Café]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Varlo]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roonadan]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles]] had been performing experiments with [[Droch/Legends|drochs]] on three [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]], [[Sligh]], [[Emala]], and [[Grees]], and began planning with recently-[[Plan Delta|ousted]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to assist her in a coup of the Imperial Remnant against [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]. The Squibs [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on Getelles during the experiments, and later offered to meet with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] to give them information. They met at the Riverview Café, but were almost immediately set upon by thugs hired by Getelles, who did not want his secrets to be revealed. Nevertheless, the Solos and Squibs escaped alive, and the Squibs relayed all of their information to the Solos in return for passage to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As a result, Fel was prepared for Daala's treachery, and was able to survive her [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt and lead his forces in [[Battle over Exodo II|battle]] against her over the planet [[Exodo II]].
